notes.author: agent:claude
notes.text: The README and the brief describe the project as open source while the repository carries no license and package.json is marked private. Choosing the license is a human decision and should be made before any public sharing, because code published without one is not usable by anyone else.

notes.author: user
notes.text: Approved publishing the repository publicly under the MIT license. Use the GitHub account identity when no legal display name is configured. npm publication remains a separate step.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Prepared public-source publication under MIT with copyright holder pioootrek, repository metadata, third-party notices, and a production dependency license review. The locked production graph contains 342 MIT, 18 ISC, 8 Apache-2.0, 7 BSD-3-Clause, 4 BSD-2-Clause, 2 BlueOak-1.0.0, and one each of 0BSD, CC-BY-4.0, LGPL-3.0-or-later, and Python-2.0. shadcn/ui copied-source attribution is preserved. Keep this item open because npm packing, clean global-install validation, pre-1.0 release confirmation, and npm publication are not part of the public repository operation.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Published https://github.com/pioootrek/worktree-switcher as a public GitHub repository with main as the default branch. GitHub recognizes the MIT license. The source archive was packed, inspected for state and secret files, installed into a clean npm prefix, and smoke-tested through config path, config mcp, and a loopback dashboard start. Keep the item open for the separate npm registry release decision; package.json intentionally remains private.

problem: The repository describes itself as open source but contains no license file, and the package is marked private and unpublished. Without a license, nobody may legally use, fork, or contribute to the code, so the contribution invitation in the README cannot be acted on.

risk.rollback: Keep the repository unpublished. A license grant cannot be reliably withdrawn from copies already distributed, so publication must not precede an explicit human decision.

scope: Have the project owner choose a license, add the license file, and reference it from README.md and package.json.
Confirm that the license of every bundled dependency and every copied shadcn/ui source component is compatible with the chosen license and attributed where required.

Prepare the npm package for a first release: remove the private flag, verify the files list ships dist, out, skills, and the license, and verify a global install exposes a working worktree-switcher executable.
Decide and document whether the first release is published under a pre-1.0 version while the data model may still change.
title: Add a license and prepare the first package release
validation: Verify the license file exists, names the copyright holder, and is referenced consistently by README.md and package.json.

Pack the release with npm pack, install the tarball globally in a clean environment, and verify worktree-switcher start serves the dashboard and worktree-switcher config mcp prints a client configuration.
Verify the packed archive contains the license and the skill directory and excludes the SQLite database, logs, and any token file.
Verify a dependency license review is recorded before the first publish.
value: The project becomes legally usable by other people, which is a precondition for the contributions, bug reports, and real worktree-heavy setups the README asks for.
